JUGGUN.description: A Hip-fire focused Modification Kit for the Stoner 96 LMG. R&D specifically clarified that the ergonomics were going to be completely different from what you have already experienced and, as compensation, fitted your weapon with an even bigger magazine, though....the budget wouldn't allow for said increase to reflect on ammunition reserves. Become War and Draw First Blood....or do like the Town Mouse and live for nothing.
JUGGUN.name: JUGGUN

HORNET.description: UNLEASH THEE BEES UPON YOUR ENEMIES!!
HORNET.name: HORNET

HK21.description: Belt-fed heavy variant of an older rifle. Fires at a high rate of speed from a 100 round box, but has awful recoil. Has a lengthy reload process.
HK21.name: HK21

M249 SAW.description:
The M249 is a Grand Federation military adaptation of the Belvaunian mini-machinegun in service since the 1980s. The gun strikes a balance of being lighter than the M60 while providing better sustained firepower than the M16.

Features an impressively high rate of fire and low recoil, but possesses relatively lackluster damage. Keep away from sand.

Model submitted by Rialag!
M249 SAW.name: M249 SAW

STONER 96.description: A lightweight LMG in 5.56x45mm NATO introduced in 1996 as a simplified version of the ARES LMG-1. The gun's low rate of fire paired with a constant-recoil system give the Stoner 96 incredibly low recoil.
STONER 96.name: STONER 96

MG42.description: The original, the iconic, the feared... The buzzsaw of the axis powers during the second world war, back to prove it's worth in the modern warzone. Fires extremely fast and hits even harder, but is slow and inaccurate.
MG42.name: MG42

SCAR HAMR.description:
Heat Adaptive Modular Rifle - a variant of the FN SCAR rifle which switches from closed to open bolt firing dependant on the heat of the barrel. At first it will fire at 550 rounds per minute, stop firing and the weapon will return to closed bolt. Uncanny stability with poor damage in closed bolt mode. Large magazine capacity making for lengthy reloads.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
SCAR HAMR.name: SCAR HAMR

M1918A2.description: The M1918A2, also known as the B.A.R. A .30-06 Light Machine gun that, while not featuring as much magazine capacity as others of its type, still helped carry the Allied Armies to victory during many World War II battles. The most solid, dependable and courageous Marine I had ever known. Blink of an eye....gone.
M1918A2.name: M1918A2

M60.description:
A belt-fed machine gun designed in the 1940s-50s to replace the M1918 BAR, combining elements of the proven Eisenmarkian MG42 and FG42 guns with Grand Federation innovations. Features a relatively low rate of fire with high damage and penetration.
Submitted by Vic.
M60.name: M60

KORD-R.description:
The KORD-R (GRAU designation: 6P62) is a bulky magazine-fed machine gun chambered in the 12.7x108mm anti-materiel cartridge, designed to provide anti-vehicle support at ranges where RPGs and grenade launchers would cause too much collateral damage while also being easier to deploy than a traditional HMG gun emplacement. In early trials, it was quickly found to be impractical due to the weight and limited use cases.

Has extremely poor handling and recoil control, but unmatched damage potential.
KORD-R.name: KORD-R
